results.answer:
Welcome! Becoming a POSP is straightforward. You will need to upload six items in total:

1. PAN card.
2. Aadhaar card (front and back photos).
3. Class 10 or 12 marksheet.
4. Bank proof (cancelled cheque, first page of passbook, or bank statement).
5. A clear selfie.

Which step of the journey are you on right now?

पॉलिसीनेस्ट (PolicyNest) में POSP एजेंट बनने के लिए आपको मुख्य रूप से 6 दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करने होंगे: पैन कार्ड, आधार कार्ड का आगे का हिस्सा, आधार कार्ड का पीछे का हिस्सा, 10वीं या 12वीं की मार्कशीट, बैंक प्रूफ (कैंसिल्ड चेक, पासबुक का पहला पेज या बैंक स्टेटमेंट), और एक सेल्फी।

आप अभी किस चरण (स्टेप) पर हैं?

You must be at least 18 years old on the date you start your application. 

Here is who can apply:
1. Age 18 or older.
2. Passed Class 10 from a recognised board, including NIOS.
3. Have a valid individual PAN card (where the fourth character is P).
4. Have a savings or current bank account in your own name.
5. Not already registered as a POSP with another insurer or intermediary.

Which step of the application are you on right now?

You are making great progress, Asha! 

1. Continue filling in your identity information on the current page.
2. Complete the remaining short pages in the Your details stage. 
3. Once you finish this stage, you will move on to uploading your documents one by one.

Your Aadhaar front photo was not accepted because it was not sharp enough to read.

1. Put your Aadhaar card on a flat surface in bright daylight.
2. Hold your phone straight above it so all four corners are clearly inside the frame.
3. Go to the Documents screen in the app, tap Replace on your Aadhaar front slot, and upload the clearer photo.

To take a clear photo, use the original document in daylight, away from glare, hold your phone straight above it, and ensure all four corners and every word are sharp. Don't worry, you can easily update your Aadhaar front photo.

1. Put your Aadhaar card on a flat surface in daylight.
2. Hold your phone straight above it with all four corners in the frame.
3. Take the photo when every word is sharp and easy to read.
4. On the Documents screen, tap Replace on your Aadhaar (front) card and upload the new photo.

आपके आधार कार्ड (सामने का भाग) की फ़ोटो साफ़ न होने के कारण इसे स्वीकार नहीं किया गया। चिंता न करें, आप इसे आसानी से ठीक कर सकते हैं:

1. आधार कार्ड को दिन की रोशनी में किसी समतल सतह पर रखें।
2. फ़ोन को उसके ठीक ऊपर सीधा पकड़ें ताकि सभी चारों कोने फ़्रेम के अंदर साफ़ दिखाई दें।
3. ऐप में दस्तावेज़ स्क्रीन पर जाकर 'Replace' (बदलें) पर टैप करें और नई फ़ोटो अपलोड करें।

Your PAN card photo was not accepted because it looks like an Aadhaar card instead of a PAN card. 

To fix this:
1. Get your actual PAN card and place it on a flat surface in daylight.
2. Hold your phone straight above it so all four corners are in the frame.
3. On the Documents step, tap Replace on your PAN card slot and upload the correct photo.

आपके आधार कार्ड की सामने की फ़ोटो धुंधली होने के कारण स्वीकार नहीं की गई है। चिंता मत कीजिए, आप इसे आसानी से ठीक कर सकते हैं:

1. अपने आधार कार्ड को दिन की रोशनी में किसी समतल सतह पर रखें।
2. फोन को उसके बिल्कुल ऊपर सीधा पकड़ें ताकि चारों कोने फ्रेम के अंदर साफ़ आएं।
3. Documents स्क्रीन पर जाएं, Aadhaar (front) के पास Replace पर टैप करें और नई फ़ोटो अपलोड करें।

Hello Kiran, don't worry, we can fix this easily. Your selfie was not accepted because the face match was low. 

1. Sit in a well-lit room with good daylight, facing the light directly.
2. Hold your phone straight and look directly at the camera without any cap or sunglasses.
3. On your Documents screen, tap **Replace** on your Selfie card and upload the new photo.

You are almost ready for the next step. All six of your documents are verified. 

1. On the Documents screen, tap 'Submit for verification'.
2. After you submit, you will move to the Verification stage before starting your training.

A good photo of an original document (not a photocopy) needs to be taken flat in daylight away from lamps, with the phone held straight above it so all four corners are in the frame and every word is sharp. For a selfie, your face must be clearly visible in good light without a cap or sunglasses. Which step are you on right now?

Your Class 10 marksheet has a date of birth mismatch, and your cancelled cheque has a bank name mismatch because the account holder name does not match your PAN. 

1. Go to the Verification page in the app.
2. For the Class 10 marksheet, upload a corrected document or official birth proof where the date of birth matches your PAN card.
3. For the bank proof, upload a cancelled cheque or bank statement in your own individual name (where you are the sole or primary holder).
4. Tap 'Send fixes for re-check'.

No, you do not need to upload everything again. You only need to fix and re-upload the specific items listed on your Verification page: your Class 10 marksheet (due to a date of birth mismatch) and your cancelled cheque (due to a bank name mismatch). 

1. Go to the Verification page in the app.
2. Replace or update the Class 10 marksheet and the cancelled cheque.
3. Tap 'Send fixes for re-check'.

नमस्ते आशा! आपके दस्तावेजों में दो चीजें ठीक करनी हैं:

1. **कक्षा 10 की मार्कशीट:** इस पर दी गई जन्म तिथि (DOB) आपके पैन कार्ड से मेल नहीं खाती। कृपया अपनी सही मार्कशीट या जन्म प्रमाण पत्र फिर से अपलोड करें।
2. **कैंसल चेक (बैंक विवरण):** बैंक खाते का नाम आपके नाम से मेल नहीं खाता। कृपया अपने नाम का कैंसल चेक या बैंक स्टेटमेंट अपलोड करें, जो आपका ही खाता हो।

**अगला कदम:**
सत्यापन संदेश में इन दोनों को ठीक करें, फिर 'Send fixes for re-check' बटन दबाएँ।

A person on our team is currently checking your application because of a surname change. 

1. Nothing is needed from you right now.
2. The review is being handled by a team member.
3. Check your dashboard for the latest status update.

No, you do not need to do anything right now. A person on our team is checking your application because of your surname change. 

1. Wait while our team completes the review. 
2. Check your dashboard for the latest status update. 

You are doing great so far!

A surname change after marriage is checked by a person on our team. Don't worry, this is a normal part of the process.

1. A person on our team is currently reviewing your application.
2. Nothing is needed from you right now.
3. The update will show on your dashboard.

Your application was not accepted because the Class 10 educational requirement was not met. Applicants must have passed Class 10 from a recognised board.

1. Check the specific details on your Verification page.
2. If you believe this is incorrect, tap 'Dispute this decision' and a person on our team will review it again.

It looks like the app could not verify your Class 10 qualification. If you believe this is a mistake, you can have a person review your details. 

1. Go to your Verification page in the app.
2. Tap the 'Dispute this decision' button.
3. Wait for an update on your status dashboard while a person checks it.

Your PAN was not accepted because the fourth character shows it belongs to a company, firm, or other entity rather than an individual. An individual PAN is required.

1. Go to the Verification page to view the details.
2. If you believe this is incorrect, tap 'Dispute this decision' and a person on the review team will take another look.

Great news, your documents are verified! Here is what you need to do next:

1. Open your app to the verification screen.
2. Press 'Start training' to begin your 15 hours of training.

The training is 15 hours in total. You have already completed 6 hours, so you are making great progress!

1. Open the training section in your app.
2. Complete the remaining modules until you reach 15 hours.
3. Once the full training time is logged, the exam will automatically unlock for you.

Don't worry, you are doing great! 

After you finish your training, here is what happens next:
1. The exam will unlock on your screen.
2. Take the POSP examination.
3. Once you pass, you will receive your certificate and POSP code.

Let me know if you need help with anything else!

sources: POSP Manual p.3 · 2.2 Document Verification Standards & Rejection Reasons / Educational Proof
